description.value: At 3rd level, the engineer can salvage electrical and mechanical parts from destroyed vehicles, constructs, and airships. Salvaging takes time based on the size of the wreckage (10 minutes for Tiny to Small up to 12 hours for Colossal). At the end of this time, the engineer makes a Perception check; if successful, he gains gil based on size (500 gil for Tiny to Small, up to 16,000 gil for Colossal). A particular vehicle, construct, or airship can be successfully salvaged only once. If the engineer salvages one of their own destroyed construct companions, they instead gain gil equal to the cost of creating that construct.
